content:
Recall starts with clinical intent

The strongest recall programs are tied to care pathways: post-procedure reviews, chronic condition check-ins, vaccination boosters, and annual screenings. When the clinical reason is clear, patients respond—and trust stays intact.

Segments that perform well

  • Diabetes and hypertension patients due for quarterly review
  • Pediatric vaccination schedules approaching due dates
  • Post-treatment follow-ups at day 7 and day 30
  • Inactive patients who have not visited in 12+ months

Channel selection

Use SMS or WhatsApp for time-sensitive reminders; use email for education-heavy content like prep guides or seasonal health tips. Always include an easy booking link and clinic phone number.

Measure recall quality, not just clicks

Track booked appointments generated by each campaign, not only open rates. A smaller list with high clinical relevance usually outperforms bulk blasts.

ClinicPro email and reminder tools connect campaigns to live schedules so recalled patients book into real availability—not a generic contact form.
